nav.tagline: Your jersey, your photos, your number.

home.title: Your custom jersey, made from your photos
home.subtitle: Pick your kit, add your photos, and watch them fill the number on your jersey. Shipping across Europe and the USA.
home.feature1Body: Ten real jerseys in the catalogue and three finish levels, from supporter to player issue.
home.feature2Body: Up to three photos. They stack vertically inside the number.
home.feature3Body: You see the exact result before ordering. A 300 dpi print file goes straight to the workshop.
